note: Where product feedback goes. A mailto address, nothing more: the page itself never sends anything, so the on-device claim and invariant 11 are untouched. Set on the owner's instruction to a personal inbox. This sits on a public page, so treat it as permanently scrapeable, and expect distress mail alongside product notes: the `feedback.notSupport` copy is what stands between a person in difficulty and an email nobody reads tonight. Swapping in a forwarding alias later is a one-line change here and nowhere else. While `address` is null the section hides itself, so an unset value ships safely.
subject: Reitti preview — a note
because: The preview exists to be argued with, and the people best placed to argue with it are clinicians and county staff who have no other way to reach us. A link that costs nothing to ship is worth more than a feedback form that would put a server between a person and their own answers.
